description: Enable PgBouncer by default (PGBOUNCER_ENABLED=true) and set per-pod connection limits. Current default is false, meaning each of 50+ backend pods maintains 10 direct PostgreSQL connections (500+ total), exceeding PostgreSQL's 100-connection limit. This forces connection timeouts and cascading failures during peak load. Configure PgBouncer in transaction pooling mode (4-connection pool per pod × 50 pods = 200 managed connections).
